paper_metadata.title: Hierarchical multi-phase microstructural architecture for exceptional strength-ductility combination in a complex concentrated alloy via high-temperature severe plastic deformation

evidence.quote: Modiﬁcation of a coarse B2 phase and realization of hierarchical multi-phase microstructures were achieved in an Al0.5CrFeCoNi complex concentrated alloy (CCA) using high-temperature severe plastic deformation (HTSPD).
